title: Translate

drop.hint: Drop a .txt, .srt, .epub, .docx or .pdf file here, or click to choose one
drop.active: Drop the file to load it
drop.hintRefine: Drop a translated .txt, .srt, .epub, .docx or .pdf file here, or click to choose one

stopping: Stopping once the current requests finish…
needConnection: Enter your API key and choose a model in the Connection section first.

status.partial: Finished, but {{count}} units are untranslated. Resume to retry them.
status.pausedInterrupted: Stopped. You can resume this translation at any time.
status.pausedRateLimit: The provider's rate limit was reached. Resume in a few minutes.
status.failed: The translation could not be completed.

reason.prepare_failed: The file could not be read.
reason.no_units: No translatable text was found in the file.
reason.reconstruct_failed: The output file could not be built.

log.title: Activity
log.unit_failed: A unit could not be translated and will be retried on resume
log.unit_error: An unexpected error occurred on a unit
log.unit_validation_exhausted: The answer stayed incomplete; the unit is marked as failed
log.empty_llm_response: The model returned nothing (likely a refusal or a content filter)
log.output_truncated: The model ran out of output tokens; try a smaller chunk size
log.unclosed_translation_tag: The model's answer was cut off
log.context_overflow_retry: The text is too long for the model, splitting it
log.context_overflow_fatal: The text is too long for the model even after splitting
log.llm_key_rotated: Rate limit hit, switching to the next API key
log.llm_rate_limit: Rate limit hit, waiting before retrying
log.rate_limited: Paused because of the provider's rate limit
log.using_raw_response_fallback: The model ignored the output format; using its raw answer
log.phase2_warning: The model could not keep the formatting tags; repositioning them automatically (placement may be slightly off)
log.fallback_untranslated: A passage could not be translated and stays in the source language
log.replace_body_error: A chapter could not be rebuilt and was left as in the source
log.epub_file_not_found: A chapter listed in the book was not found and was skipped
log.epub_xml_error: A chapter could not be read and was left untranslated
log.pdf_no_text: The PDF has no text layer (is it a scan?), so there is nothing to translate

text_cleanup: Repair OCR errors and broken line breaks while translating
